title: feat(connector-github): pin the two included MCP tools and record the listing provenance
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99NHVBVyv4gRvhhpXs72Am2)_

Fixes #28647

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：GitHub 连接器应用给它用到的两个 MCP 工具（`search_issues`、`issue_read`）各加了一个 sha256 锁定值，README 新增「Provenance」一节，写明上游地址、锁定值、谁在什么时候用什么 token 测的，以及上架清单 sha256 的算法和结果。
- 为什么改：按 #28590 的裁决 B，货架上的每个 MCP 应用都要锁定它包含的工具，清单的 sha256 就是这组锁定值的摘要；GitHub 以后改了工具定义，实例会降级并点名工具，而不是悄悄换行为。
- 风险与回滚：锁定值是 2026-11-06 维护者本机用权限较宽的 `gh` token 测的；如果只读 token 拿到的工具定义不同，连接器首次连接会降级并点名该工具（重测、换锁定值即可）。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。应用是私有包，不发 npm。
- 先看：`packages/apps/connector-github/src/connectors/github.connector.ts`（新增 `toolsSnapshot`）、`packages/apps/connector-github/README.md`（Provenance 一节）、`packages/apps/connector-github/test/listing.test.ts`（新的锁定值测试块）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-github test`，预期 2 个文件、18 个测试全绿，不访问 GitHub。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`src/connectors/github.connector.ts`**: `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` pins both included tools, with the digests posted on #30116 (comment 6691107153) verbatim:
  - `search_issues`: `443421e063c9330d4504a88b57def74d1f1e3d0793479068073630a1846eaeb0`
  - `issue_read`: `380e96f3d78b5c893668ab48a2d72191a3906bdc4e5e5c89f9e92c3e9de6c392`
- **`README.md`**: a new `## Provenance` section, following the shape the Stripe and DocuSign apps use for their listing provenance (a README section; no manifest field carries provenance in this repository). It records `upstream` (the server URL), how `commit` is recorded (the repository commit the package is published from; a file cannot name the commit that contains it, so the publisher records it), the two pins, the measurement date (2026-11-06T17:27Z), who measured them (the maintainer, on their own machine), the token used (the maintainer's local `gh` CLI token, broader than read-only, as triage asked to record), the pin-set sha256 `e922e2420b05707fb3ec9df270009da30d57177c297a6d7c3ee0b4ccbbad7516`, and the exact recipe with a one-line `printf | sha256sum` that reproduces it.
- **`test/fixtures/github-mcp-tools.json`** (new): the measurement's stdout from #30116, the two tool definitions included, so the pins are recomputed offline.
- **`test/listing.test.ts`**: a new top-level `describe('connector-github tool pins')` in the existing listing harness. It fails when an included tool has no pin, a pin is not 64 lowercase hex, or a pin names a tool `include` leaves out; it recomputes both pins from the fixture with `computeMcpToolsSnapshot`; and it checks the README records the URL, each pin and the pin-set digest. No network call.
- **`test/boot.test.ts`** (forced test edit): the fake MCP server now serves the measured definitions from the fixture instead of hand-written stand-ins. With the pins in place, the old stand-ins hash differently, so the instance would degrade with `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_CHANGED` and three boot tests would fail (measured below). The extra `issue_write` tool the app must not expose is kept.

The pin-set digest recipe: serialize the `toolsSnapshot` record as JSON with keys sorted (UTF-16 code-unit order) and no whitespace, which for a record of strings is its RFC 8785 (JCS) form, then sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex. The card names this `stableStringify`; no repository-wide `stableStringify` is exported (four private copies exist), so the README states the rules instead of a function name.

No changeset: `@objectstack/connector-app-github` is `private: true`, so it publishes nothing; the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

- Step 0, offline recompute: `computeMcpToolsSnapshot` over the fixture's `tools` gives exactly the two posted digests (`search_issues MATCH`, `issue_read MATCH`), at `69244406`.
- Base (`69244406`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-app-github test`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 14 passed.
- Head: the same command: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 18 passed; `typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/connector-mcp test`: Test Files 9 passed, Tests 119 passed.
- Ablations (each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which restores and checks the blob; `git diff HEAD` empty after each):
  - Drop the `issue_read` pin: listing tests red, `expected [ 'issue_read: no pin' ] to deeply equal []`; 4 failed, 9 passed.
  - Malformed pin (the `search_issues` pin in uppercase hex): red, `expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []`; 4 failed, 9 passed.
  - Boot fake back to the pre-pin stand-in definitions: 3 boot tests red, the instance `degraded` with `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot does not match the tools its MCP server serves: tool 'search_issues' changed …; tool 'issue_read' changed …`. This is the forced boot-test edit, measured.

## Acceptance notes

- The pins were measured with the maintainer's local `gh` token, not a read-only one. If GitHub serves a read-only token different definitions for these two tools, the first connection degrades the instance naming the tool; re-measure with a read-only token and re-pin. Triage (6723942187) ruled that a follow-up, not a blocker.
- The declaration above is measured, not copied: `toolsSnapshot` is an existing `providerConfig` key the `mcp` provider already reads; this PR adds data to it. The app's metadata format and the spec are unchanged.

- Two of them first exited 3 on container prerequisites, not on the diff, and were green on rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit was outside the shallow clone; fetched it), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`; ran a full `pnpm build` under the verify lock, exit 0).
